about.title: About Me
introduction: I'm Dev Kabir, a Senior Web Developer and WordPress Specialist with more than five years of experience building scalable web applications and fast, reliable WordPress plugins.

I work with PHP, JavaScript, React.js, Vue 3, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, Node.js, and the WordPress ecosystem. My experience includes custom plugin development, WooCommerce integrations, REST APIs, WP-CLI, performance optimization, and secure API development.

experience.description: Migrated a core plugin structure from Vue 2 to Vue 3 using the Composition API, modernizing the architecture and reducing technical debt across 60K+ lines of code. Contributed to Defender and Beehive, shipped updates through a CI/CD pipeline, and collaborated with an international team.
Created and maintained a CORS error-solving plugin adopted by 6,000+ websites worldwide, while providing long-term support, updates, and documentation for the open-source WordPress community.

Delivered 38+ custom WordPress plugins with consistent 5-star ratings. Built secure, scalable WooCommerce integrations with payment gateways, shipping providers, CRMs, and analytics platforms through REST APIs.
